extraction_notes: Source PDF is image-only; values were read from the supplied manufacturer datasheet pages and plots.
Curve points are direct visual digitizations from the plotted traces and grid; no interpolation or fitted values were added.

Page 1 absolute maximum and thermal values: VDS = 60 V; VGS = +/-20 V; ID = 450 mA at VGS = 10 V and TA = 25 degC; ID = 360 mA at TA = 70 degC; IDM = 950 mA; PD = 0.7 W at TA = 25 degC; operating/storage junction range = -55 to 150 degC; RthJA = 180 degC/W on the stated 1 in^2 FR4 copper-pad condition.

Page 2 additional table values: breakdown-voltage temperature coefficient typical = 0.06 V/degC referenced to 25 degC at ID = 1 mA; gfs typical = 400 mS at VDS = 10 V and ID = 450 mA; IDSS maximum = 10 uA at VDS = 60 V and VGS = 0 V; IDSS maximum = 100 uA at TJ = 70 degC, VDS = 48 V and VGS = 0 V; IGSS maximum = +/-30 uA at VGS = +/-20 V and VDS = 0 V.

Page 2 gate-charge and timing values: Qg typical = 1 nC and maximum = 1.6 nC at ID = 450 mA; Qgs typical = 0.5 nC at VDS = 50 V; Qgd typical = 0.5 nC at VGS = 4.5 V; td(on) typical = 12 ns, tr typical = 10 ns, td(off) typical = 56 ns, tf typical = 29 ns, with VDS = 30 V, ID = 450 mA, RG = 3.3 ohm, VGS = 10 V, and RD = 52 ohm as shown in the merged test-condition cells.

The threshold table has no typical value. The RDS(on) table publishes maximum values only. Ciss maximum = 50 pF is also published in addition to the typical 32 pF; no separate maximum fields exist in the strict schema.
The supplied datasheet has no numeric reverse-recovery trr or Qrr table entry.
